notes: Fixed places worth marking on a map that tarkov.dev has no label for. The ETL adds them to the map in both modes.
position is raw game x/y/z in metres (y is height, which picks the floor).

marked-circle-bunker: the position is tarkov.dev's Bunker_enter zone from Hindsight 20/20 (objective 674602682cb1c1f5999f27aa). MapGenie's Marked Circle Bunker marker fell 2 m from that quest's first ammo stash inside the bunker when scaled onto our extracts (checked 2026-11-01).

waysIn: how to reach an extract when the way isn't obvious, from guides. extracts are extract ids from data/maps/<map>.json; routes show in its popup and spots draw as faint dots while it's open. Spots have no height because the sources don't give a floor.

Factory yard spots: MapGenie's two window markers fitted onto seven of our extracts and transits (2-6 m off, so they're approximate). Routes: guides from August 2024 and November 2025. Neither is confirmed in game (checked 2026-11-02).

places.name: Marked Circle Bunker
places.note: Entrance to the underground bunker with a marked circle inside, the same one as Hindsight 20/20. Door reported open with no key needed (January 2025).

routes: Ground floor: offices' front-left door, first door on the right, vault the window behind the desk.
2nd floor: out the bathroom or locker room window.
